caption_used: 此图展示了粘合式“an”结构的构成特点，由两个饼图组成。主饼图（左侧）显示：单音形容词+单音名词结构占比为69.39%（229例），双音形容词+单音名词结构占比为30.61%（101例）。子饼图（右侧）对双音形容词+单音名词结构进一步细分：“的”字隐不显占73.27%，“的”字显不隐占26.73%。两图之间通过连接线标示从属关系。从数据来看，无论是主结构还是子结构，占主导地位的类型均占据约七成比例，呈现出相似的分布规律。
raw_response: DESCRIPTION: This figure, titled "粘合式 'an' 结构" (Bonded 'an' Structure), presents a two-part pie chart illustrating the structural composition of the "an" construction in Chinese. The main pie chart on the left displays two categories: "单音形容词+单音名词" (monosyllabic adjective + monosyllabic noun), which accounts for 69.39% of the total (229 instances), represented by a yellow slice, and "双音形容词+单音名词" (disyllabic adjective + monosyllabic noun), which accounts for 30.61% (101 instances), represented by a blue slice. A secondary pie chart on the right, connected to the blue slice of the main chart, further breaks down the "双音形容词+单音名词" category. It shows "‘的’字只隐不现" (the 'de' character is only implicit, not explicit) at 81.66% (orange slice) and "‘的’字只现不隐" (the 'de' character is only explicit, not implicit) at 18.34% (green slice). The chart includes a legend at the bottom indicating the color coding for the three categories. The data is explicitly labeled with percentages and instance counts within each slice, and the visual structure clearly indicates a hierarchical relationship between the main and sub-categories.
